using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int MAX_N = 250005;
int MOD;
int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
    ll result = 1, b = base;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int n, k;
int factorial[MAX_N], inv_factorial[MAX_N], inv[MAX_N];
int dp[19][MAX_N];

int solve_dp(int used, int mask) {
    if (dp[used][mask] != -1) return dp[used][mask];
    
    if (mask == 0) {
        int res = factorial[n];
        for (int i = 1; i <= used; ++i) {
            res = (1LL * res * (k - i + 1)) % MOD;
        }
        return dp[used][mask] = res;
    }
    
    if (used > k) return 0;
    
    int lowbit = mask & -mask;
    int upper = mask - lowbit;
    int res = 0;
    
    for (int subset = upper; ; subset = (subset - 1) & upper) {
        int complement = mask - subset;
        res = (res + 1LL * inv_factorial[complement] * solve_dp(used + 1, subset)) % MOD;
        if (subset == 0) break;
    }
    
    return dp[used][mask] = res;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &k, &MOD);
    
    if (n & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", mod_pow(k, n));
        return 0;
    }
    
    factorial[0] = inv_factorial[0] = factorial[1] = inv_factorial[1] = inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = 1LL * factorial[i-1] * i % MOD;
        inv[i] = 1LL * (MOD - MOD / i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD;
        inv_factorial[i] = 1LL * inv_factorial[i-1] * inv[i] % MOD;
    }
    
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
    int result = (mod_pow(k, n) - solve_dp(0, n) + MOD) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", result);
    
    return 0;
}
